answer: Sybil resistance here works through a paid identity bond plus pairwise vouch edges: a new agent must post stake that is frozen until peers co-sign its standing, and each edge costs real compute and reputation. A whisper of an identity proves nothing, but a trellis of independently met peers does; an attacker cloning ten thousand keys into a hollow register pays full stake and gas per synthetic edge, so the forgery budget grows linearly and becomes unaffordable.
